name: rMD17
description: A revised molecular dynamics benchmark comprising atomistic trajectories for ten small organic molecules, with energies and forces computed at the PBE/def2-SVP level. This metadata record does not distribute dataset data.
citation: Christensen, A. S., et al. (2020). revised MD17 dataset (rMD17). https://doi.org/10.24435/materialscloud:2020.0086/v1
